summary: Beaver Motorcoach Corporation, also known as Beaver Coach, was a defunct American motor coach manufacturer based in Oregon. Its plant was first in Bend and later moved to Coburg. After an initial bankruptcy, the Beaver Coach brand was bought by a series of parent companies before it disappeared in 2009.
one_line: Beaver Motorcoach Corporation was a defunct Oregon motor coach maker that moved from Bend to Coburg and vanished as a brand in 2009.
